gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Wide-spaced and unclosed, Offside draws its curves like a neon sign that never finishes the loop. Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals, so the text reads like a solid band.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada reads friendly and modern, with only a gentle step up from small letters to capitals. Offside, though, would feel stiff and strained if shrunk down, while the body font holds up at any size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li draws brush-like ends that lift away before each curve closes, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. And Offside does the loud work, its pen line wide-tracked and commanding, while the body simply keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, its curves never quite closing back on themselves. Offside's glassy tubing stays brighter.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Offside spaces its letters wide and draws them without hairlines or swells, so the heading hums at one level. And Noto Sans Khmer follows with generous notch-like openings and upright small letters, which make a longer read feel steady.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Commanding, a little unfinished, Offside leaves its curves open and spreads its letters wide across the line. And Noto Sans Khojki answers with exits wide enough to pass light and a large eye on every e, so heading and text sit together comfortably.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Bent-tube letters, spaced far apart, give Offside a sign-shop swagger that never closes its curves. Noto Sans Khudawadi stays low and open beneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-kr: Offside never closes its curves, and its wide tracking gives the heading a level, unhurried beat. And Noto Sans KR feels crisp next to it, with generous gaps, stubby ascenders and a big x-height.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Offside spreads its letters wide and leaves every curve open, with no pinched joints or flared ends anywhere. And Noto Sans Lao Looped packs words into solid blocks with bowls left open on one side, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Stencil-brush plain and widely tracked, Offside leaves its curves unclosed and commands the top of the page. Noto Sans Lepcha, with cast-iron lowercase, holds a longer read steady.
